scope: Additive primary-source Healing Tome L1-18 post-September-2024 duration table; heal pulse and aura combat remain partial.
game_version: Supercell 2024-08-27 announcement for the September 2024 balance update. Current September 2026 executable and later unlisted changes are unverified.

sources.title: 關於9月平衡性調整即將上線的公告！ (Announcement of Upcoming September Balance Changes!)
facts: The official Traditional Chinese September balance table prints before-and-after Healing Tome ability duration for all 18 levels; the post-change durations match every retained normalized row.
sources.limitations: The table does not publish heal rate, pulse cadence, aura radius, target eligibility, start/end tick or Warden recovery order.

derivations.result: All 18 retained abilityDuration values match the official September 2024 post-change table and each is an exact 10 ms multiple.
derivations.method: Transcribe the post-change duration column, convert source seconds to integer milliseconds, compare each immutable normalized source_fields.stats.abilityDuration string, and do not infer a heal pulse schedule.

rejected_inferences.rule: Heal once per 10 ms tick for the confirmed duration
rejected_inferences.reason: Ability duration supplies no heal pulse cadence or integer accumulation rule.

rejected_inferences.rule: Use the retained healingPerSecond field as a current value
rejected_inferences.reason: The official duration table has no healing-rate column and no current executable trace is available.

rejected_inferences.rule: Apply the effect to every friendly entity in the Warden's generic range
rejected_inferences.reason: Neither the official table nor introduction defines the aura radius, entity filters or entry/exit geometry.

rejected_inferences.rule: Enable Healing Tome activation in Core
rejected_inferences.reason: Command phase, first pulse, target enumeration, recovery and death order are unresolved.

items: current duration continuity and healing-rate values
aura center, radius, boundary and eligible in-scope entities
first pulse, interval, integer accumulation and rounding
activation, expiry, movement, death and simultaneous heal/damage order
Warden separate recovery and HP bonus application and stacking
Viewer control and aura overlay, snapshot, replay and RL activation state

conclusion: Healing Tome L1-18 duration values have direct primary numeric corroboration. Healing rate, aura geometry and fixed-tick pulse semantics remain partial, so no combat effect is enabled.
